definitions.explanation: A neutral term for husband. This is the most straightforward word for referring to one's spouse without the hierarchical implications of {主人|しゅじん}.

examples.japanese: {夫|おっと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My husband is at work now.

examples.japanese: {夫|おっと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went shopping with my husband.

examples.japanese: {夫|おっと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んで→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦くれます→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My husband plays with the children on his days off.

examples.japanese: {夫|おっと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}いました→知り合う：03072_shiriau⟧。⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{二十|にじゅう}→二十：00975_nijuu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I met my husband when we were students. It's been twenty years now.

notes: {夫|おっと} is a neutral term for 'husband' and is increasingly preferred by modern Japanese speakers who find ⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧ too formal or hierarchical. It's commonly used in official documents and neutral speech. The female equivalent is ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧. In casual conversation, many people also use ⟦{旦那|だんな}→旦那：12330_danna⟧ (danna) for husband.
